c.title: $4,350 / 2br - 801ft2 - 2 Bedroom at Fourth + Mac — Kitsilano | Available October 1, 2026 (Vancouver)
c.description:
Live in the heart of Kitsilano at Fourth + Mac, a modern zero carbon rental community at West 4th Ave & Macdonald Street. Steps to Fresh Street Market, Shoppers Drug Mart, cafés, fitness studios, beaches, and major bus routes to UBC and downtown. This is walk everywhere living with Kits’ best lifestyle at your door.

Home Features
• City + water views
• Full size appliance package
• Individual air conditioning
• In suite flex room for storage or workspace
• Private balcony
• Under cabinet LED lighting
• Medicine cabinet in bathroom
• In suite laundry

Neighborhood
• West 4th retail, restaurants, cafés, fitness studios
• Easy access to bus routes 44 & 84 (UBC + downtown)
• Beaches within minutes

Building Features
• Zero carbon operations
• 100% smoke free
• Keyless entry + FOB access
• Professionally managed by Third Space
• Secure parcel lockers
• Pet friendly
• Storage lockers available

Amenities
• The Hub — lobby + co working space with flexible work areas
• The Lounge — social lounge with big screen TV, pool table, and outdoor patio
• The Roof — rooftop with BBQ stations, dining zone, garden plots, play areas, and lounge spaces
• Dedicated wash room for sandy paws + muddy bikes
• High speed Wi Fi in most amenity spaces
